summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting a major project award for subsea umbilical handling, spooling, and storage services. Koil Energy Solutions, Inc. will deploy a newly acquired mobile offshore carousel and an existing carousel to execute the work. No specific monetary terms, share prices, or special-situations transactions are disclosed. The award is described as a pivotal moment for the company but is a routine operational contract, not an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. The filing is purely a material definitive agreement for services.
